summary: Runway grants every new account 125 one-time credits for AI video and image generation (Gen-4 and friends). The credits do not renew; upgrade or wait for promotional refreshes for more.
claim_steps: Create a free account at runwayml.com.
Receive the one-time 125-credit grant on signup.
Generate video or images from the dashboard, spending credits per run.
Upgrade to Standard when the one-time credits run out.

social_proof.title: AI Image and Video Pricing from $12/month | Runway AI
social_proof.text: Compare Runway pricing plans for AI video generation. Choose from Free, Standard, Pro and Max plans with flexible credit
